calibration.metadata_correction: Initial probe used generic demonstration policy metadata. Replayed all 96 with actual policy identities; public transitions and outcomes are identical. Original exploratory artifacts preserved separately.

ordering_witness.continuation: Replay identical public prefix, change one advertised legal action, then use the same frozen greedy network.

search_recovery_probe.meaning: No single-action win found in the bounded exhaust/Vantom probe; the heuristic whole-fight witness still won that calibration case.

ordering_witness.selected_from: Exploratory calibration ordering diagnostic, independent of search benchmark outcomes.

protocol.allocation: Four rounds of all 12 scenarios in declared order, one independent game seed per case; identical starts for greedy/root/Gumbel.

calibration.dispositions: 12 families retained, four without a demonstrated calibration win excluded. No inventory was tuned after calibration.
calibration.rule: Retain families with at least one completed network or heuristic win among two calibration seeds. No search outcomes used.

protocol.primary_contrast: Gumbel minus greedy on the 32 predeclared challenge starts; control and overall results are descriptive.
protocol.secondary_contrast: Root-only minus greedy; return, exit HP and potion use are descriptive.
protocol.serial_timing: Repeat Gumbel for the first declared scenario of each deck profile using exactly its original private replay seed and limits; four repeats excluded from efficacy denominators.
protocol.stopping: Fixed 48-case panel once; no outcome-adaptive extension, search tuning or exclusions.
protocol.uncertainty: Conservative paired source-fight Hoeffding 95% bounds; repeated timing executions are not independent cases.

serial.selection: First declared scenario of each deck profile (Slimes controls)

validation.independent_review: No blockers; distinct cancellation/planned-denominator and benchmark tracking identity check passed
